| Mood | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 🌟 thriving | 99.9% uptime, touched grass, evolved |
| 😊 content | healthy, boring, the dream |
| 😴 sleepy | idle so long it started dreaming of packets |

| 🤒 sick | crash-looping, has the sniffles (the sniffles are OOMKills) |
| 😰 stressed | CPU at 97%, needs a juice box and a smaller workload |
| 😢 sad | some vital dipped under 50, general disappointment in you |
